FAQs: Do you work with founders outside the US? Yes. US Company in 10 Working Days, the International Founder Plan and Form 5472 are built for founders running a US company from abroad.

FAQs: Are you a CPA firm? No. Finance Department LLC prepares books, filings and returns. Muhammad Talha is not a CPA, an enrolled agent or a lawyer, so audits and IRS representation go to licensed US professionals.

FAQs: How do payments work? Fixed fees, paid when you sign. Monthly plans are charged monthly in advance, and you can leave with a full handover on 30 days' notice. Books Catch Up and the Investor Ready Sprint are half to start and half on delivery.
FAQs: What if a deadline is missed? Each service's guarantee says exactly what we pay or refund, and it is written into your terms before you pay.
FAQs: Do you find us investors? No. We do not introduce investors or take a success fee. You run your raise; we make sure what you send investors holds up.
FAQs: What happens on the call? Thirty minutes on what you need and what it costs. If we are a fit, you get a written proposal with fixed fees.
